notes: Names for the conversations' functions, labels, locals and globals, edited by hand. library: the compiler's shared functions, by body (applied in every slot). slots: per conversation, for the block with that sha256; functions by hex address with their labels (hex addresses) and locals (frame offsets), globals by memory address. When a block differs, names follow each function's body. Made first by NameScreening; see docs/MANUAL.md, Conversations.

063b707d493ca0bd.name: wearing_signet_ring
063b707d493ca0bd.note: babl_hack(10): whether the player wears the Guardian's signet ring (uw2 conv/BABLHACK.C).

091191448d5c74ee.name: set_attitude_and_end
091191448d5c74ee.note: Sets npc_attitude to the argument, and the conversation ends.

1283a5c1bdb31d0c.name: time_has_passed
1283a5c1bdb31d0c.note: Returns 1 when at least the first argument's days and minutes have passed since the time in the second.

17317fa230389218.name: player_in_pits
17317fa230389218.note: babl_hack(4): whether the player is in the pits (uw2 conv/BABLHACK.C).

18db4225c8c0d4ce.name: quest131_bit
18db4225c8c0d4ce.note: Bit n of quest 131: returns it, or for n + 1000 sets it and returns 1 if it was clear.

27c53af4d88656d2.name: make_offer
27c53af4d88656d2.note: Barter: do_offer with this conversation's strings; when the offer is taken, sets the global that ends the barter menu (main clears it).

2fef0f4d9f78bc87.name: go_home_and_end
2fef0f4d9f78bc87.note: The NPC heads home (goal 1), and the conversation ends.

30656b400a104de0.name: time_since
30656b400a104de0.note: Stores in the first argument the days and minutes since the time in the second.

3d51529aee953109.name: pit_fight_2
3d51529aee953109.note: Challenges the talker to a pit fight and sends both to the second pit.

44fba0177e02ed0b.name: pit_fight_3
44fba0177e02ed0b.note: Challenges the talker to a pit fight and sends both to the third pit.

4c53760d8f78acba.name: pit_fight_4
4c53760d8f78acba.note: Challenges the talker to a pit fight and sends both to the fourth pit.

899eb30170c3f52f.name: time_left
899eb30170c3f52f.note: Stores in the first argument what is left of the second's span, counted from the time in the third.

961eef46abfe89b6.name: rumor_state
961eef46abfe89b6.note: A rumour's state: 1 told, 2 ready to tell, 3 ready and then spent, 0 not yet (by quest or X clock).

b6af64976ceee0b0.name: flee_and_end
b6af64976ceee0b0.note: The NPC flees the player (goal 6, target 1, attitude upset), and the conversation ends.

bc30426acef1c964.name: pit_fight_1
bc30426acef1c964.note: Challenges the talker to a pit fight and sends both to the first pit.

c0d2c7dacf6e2554.name: ran_from_pit_fight
c0d2c7dacf6e2554.note: babl_hack(1): whether the player ran from a pit fight, cleared once read (uw2 conv/BABLHACK.C).

c71aef93f93b9ae3.name: pick_quest134_line
c71aef93f93b9ae3.note: Picks a number 1-9 once (kept in quest 134) and returns string 21 + that number.

ca285f8b3d1d6ac6.name: pick_rumor
ca285f8b3d1d6ac6.note: Finds the next rumour to tell from the two rumour tables, by rumor_state.

d26935bc51205b74.name: end_conversation
d26935bc51205b74.note: Sets the global the conversation reads as met_before (the player has talked to it) and stops the script (EXIT).

e51d3ad085855c30.name: become_ally
e51d3ad085855c30.note: npc_attitude 6: the NPC becomes the player's ally.

e701376b2ddb12ff.name: challenge_to_pit_fight
e701376b2ddb12ff.note: babl_hack(0): the talker becomes the player's pit fighter (uw2 conv/BABLHACK.C).

ed5359e9f69cba1b.name: player_tile
ed5359e9f69cba1b.note: x_obj_pos mode 2: the player's tile and height into the three arguments (uw2 conv/BABLHACK.C).

ee4cc39321a7c8f1.name: attack_and_end
ee4cc39321a7c8f1.note: The NPC attacks the player (goal 5, target 1, attitude upset), and the conversation ends.

fb64f4e87b507314.name: get_time
fb64f4e87b507314.note: Stores the time (game_days, game_mins) in the argument's two words.

fbdba8fac750ea14.name: npc_not_hostile
fbdba8fac750ea14.note: Returns 0 when the NPC is set on the player (goal 5, 6 or 9 with target 1) or hostile (attitude 0), else 1.
